title: Exception
description: exception/v1: the document an exception event carries. A party declares that what a trade needs cannot complete as it stands: the receiver on a declaration of the collateral its check refuses, or on a trade whose execution failed. The event cites the declaration or the trade. The exception never changes on the log; it is resolved by what cites it afterwards: the receiver's acceptance of a corrected declaration, the pledger's report of a reset plan, or an accepted manual resolve. One exception may name several lines or legs, so the counterparty answers the whole finding once.

exceptionId.description: Identity of this exception, minted by the facade.

tradeId.description: The trade the exception is about: its trade-booked or trade-proposed event.

reportId.description: The margin call the collateral answers, on an exception about a declaration.

status.description: Always open as written. Every organization derives whether it is resolved from what cites it, so all of them read the same answer.

code.description: What kind of finding this is. collateral-incomplete: booked lines are short, posting the rest fixes it. collateral-incorrect: a line arrived that was not booked, a movement went elsewhere or did not complete. execution-failed: a leg of the execution failed.

blame.description: The role whose side the problem is on. Not an allocation of fault: a ledger being unavailable is a side, not a mistake.

reason.description: The finding in the raiser's own words, for the counterparty to act on.

details.description: One finding per line, posting or leg.

leg.description: The leg of the execution, on an execution finding.

expected.description: The booked quantity, or what the posting said.
